metadata.title: Community
metadata.description: Explore the Orthovet Community proposal: conversations between veterinarians, case sharing and different perspectives on planning.

preview.title: A conversation opens possibilities
preview.description: Exchange references and discuss planning with other professionals, with the case context close at hand.

facts.note: A proposal for Orthovet's evolution. The features presented here are being planned.

overview.title: Exchange perspectives
overview.lead: A case can raise questions worth discussing. The Community proposal brings veterinarians together within Orthovet, creating a space to share experience, discuss references and look at planning from different perspectives.
overview.connections: The idea is to help you find other professionals and start direct conversations within the environment where you organize your work. Each exchange might begin with a question, an observation or a planning detail you would like to discuss.
overview.context: We also want to bring these conversations closer to the cases. Sharing selected references can help explain what is being reviewed, providing the context needed for a discussion that goes beyond a standalone message.
overview.perspectives: This area is being planned. Its purpose is to support collaboration between colleagues while keeping the interpretation of information and clinical decisions with the professionals involved.

modules.title: Conversations with context
modules.description: Connections, cases and new perspectives. A proposal to bring professionals together for more informed discussions about planning.

connections.title: Professional connections
connections.description: Find colleagues and start direct conversations to share experience from your daily work.

cases.title: Case discussions
cases.description: Bring case references into the conversation to give context to what you want to discuss.

discussion.title: Different perspectives
discussion.description: Share observations and bring together different perspectives on planning.

availability.question: Is Community available yet?
availability.answer: The Community shown on this page is part of Orthovet's planned evolution. The illustrations show the proposed experience; the features and their availability are still to be defined.

conversations.question: Will there be a feed or direct conversations?
conversations.answer: The initial focus is direct conversations between professionals. We want to make it easier for colleagues to exchange information and experience, with space to discuss cases and planning references.

sharing.question: Will all my cases be shared?
sharing.answer: The proposal is for the professional to choose what to bring into each conversation. Automatically sharing all cases is not part of the idea presented here; access and sharing details are still to be defined.

decisions.question: How does collaboration relate to planning?
decisions.answer: Conversations may help bring together observations and different perspectives on a case. Reviewing the information and making clinical decisions remain the responsibility of the professionals involved.
